headline: 60 kmph winds: Storms and thunderstorms feared in Dhaka and other districts
summary: Weather alerts issued for several regions including the capital, with wind speeds expected to reach up to 60 kmph by 9 AM.
details: Severe thunderstorms and strong winds are expected to hit Dhaka and several other districts across Bangladesh.
According to the weather forecast, wind speeds could reach up to 60 kilometers per hour in the affected areas.
The alert specifies that these weather conditions are likely to occur by 9 AM, urging residents to take necessary precautions.
Local authorities and weather monitoring agencies are tracking the storm's movement to provide further updates on the potential impact.

headline: Friday alert: 5-hour power cuts in several areas across Bangladesh
summary: Scheduled maintenance work will lead to prolonged electricity outages in multiple regions this Friday.
details: Several areas across Bangladesh will experience continuous power outages for up to five hours this Friday.
The electricity cuts are scheduled as part of necessary maintenance work on the power grid and distribution lines.
Residents in the affected regions are advised to make necessary preparations to manage the power shortage during this window.
Specific lists of affected areas are typically released by the power distribution companies to inform the public.
